data.description: I was unaware that it could take 2…
data.content:
I was unaware that it could take 2 weeks for Lulu and Georgia to process or ship an order or small soft goods. This feels like really poor planning and management of their operations.

When I reached out via their chat function, because their phone lines have been terminated at this time, the person (or bot) that was assisting me basically told me that I should have clicked through multiple links to find out that this was in fact the case.

This information should be directly on the product pages like most other online retailers. If I have to hunt for the information then it feels like you are trying to hide it on purpose.

As a professional that had multiple client orders affected by Interior Define and their lack of transparency and what later feels like theft I caution companies erring on the side of not being transparent. Because some of these characteristics feel like the beginning of issues at ID and later massive financial implications for Trade members.

Be transparent about your lead times, that way I can communicate with my clients the appropriate expectations. And I won't feel like you are purposely trying to hide things and evade being held accountable.
